TheProblem.title: Doctors spend more time on paperwork than on patients
TheProblem.subtitle: Administration has become one of the biggest bottlenecks in healthcare. It weighs on doctors, and on the care they can give.

data.description: Valuable clinical information is lost due to a lack of integration.

language.title: In your patient’s language
language.description: Patients answer in their own language. You read the summary in yours.

liability.title: Fully documented
liability.description: Every intake, conversation and document is kept in one clear record. You can always find what was said.

care.title: Better care
care.description: The intake is done before the patient walks in. Your time goes to the examination and the conversation.

accuracy.title: Accurate records
accuracy.description: What the patient tells you goes straight into a structured record. Fewer errors, the same structure every time.

caregiver.title: Be a caregiver again.
caregiver.description: Less time behind the screen, more time with your patients. That is why you chose this profession.

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.description: Bookings from intake, triage and the phone come together in one agenda, with priority for urgent cases.

preConsultation.title: Pre Consultation
preConsultation.description: An intake over WhatsApp, in the patient’s language. You read the history before the consultation starts.

scribe.title: Scribe
scribe.description: Listens during the consultation, on your phone or computer. The note is ready when the patient leaves.

documentGeneration.title: Document Generation
documentGeneration.description: Reports, referral letters and explanations for the patient, drafted from the consultation and ready to review.

smartTriage.title: Smart Triage
smartTriage.description: Assesses the urgency of every question and routes patients to the right care. Your team can see why.

voiceReception.title: Voice Reception
voiceReception.description: Answers the phone, asks the right questions and books routine appointments straight away. Urgent calls go to your team.

smartFollowUp.title: Smart Follow-ups
smartFollowUp.description: Short check-ins after a procedure. When an answer deviates from the expected recovery, your team gets an alert.

medication.title: Medication Manager
medication.description: A photo of a box, a list or a handwritten note becomes a structured medication list.
